print: SETTLED_CALLS.md 3a: the tape of record, open = first row at/after HH:00:00Z within 600 s, close = first row at/after HH+1:00:00Z within 600 s
registration: all bars of day D whose open is at least 1 800 s after the registration time, registered once at the start of D by the routine (or by a laptop session before the bars open)
rule: for each coin and each registered bar of day D: UP or DOWN by a seeded draw, seed = sha256(registering_commit_sha + ':' + coin + ':' + bar_start_iso), UP iff the first byte is even
mechanism: the bench (the panel @ 45:03: it is kept only to be beaten)
